landing.meta.title: HolPro — Unlock yourself.
landing.meta.description: Find your coach in sport, nutrition, mindset and habits. A personal assistant agent keeps your plan on track between sessions.
landing.nav.label: Main navigation
landing.brand.name: HolPro
landing.hero.eyebrow: Coaching, with an agent on your side
landing.hero.title: Unlock yourself.
landing.hero.body: Efficient access to the best coaches in sport, nutrition, mindset and habits. A personal assistant agent keeps your plan on track between sessions.
landing.audiences.title: Built for the person, the coach and the team.
landing.how.title: A coach sets the direction. An agent keeps the pace.
landing.how.photo: A man practising mindfulness with his eyes closed and palms together
landing.features.title: Everything between sessions, handled.
landing.disciplines.label: Coaching disciplines
landing.coaches.title: Leverage, without losing the personal touch.
landing.coaches.body: Freelancers and teams get an agentic infrastructure that follows up, tracks progress and prepares each session. You stay the coach. The agent does the admin.
landing.coaches.photo: A coach working at a laptop
landing.coaches.onboard: Onboard clients in minutes, not weeks
landing.coaches.week: See every client's week at a glance
landing.coaches.methods: Your methods, applied consistently by the agent
landing.cta.title: Ready to unlock yourself?
landing.cta.body: Pick a goal, meet your coach and get started.
landing.footer.label: Footer navigation
landing.audiences.1.label: For you
landing.audiences.1.title: Find the right coach, then keep going
landing.audiences.1.body: Matched to vetted coaches by goal. Your assistant agent turns the plan into daily steps and checks in.
landing.audiences.2.label: For coaches
landing.audiences.2.title: Help more people in the same hours
landing.audiences.2.body: Agentic infrastructure handles follow-ups, progress tracking and scheduling, so your time goes to coaching.
landing.audiences.3.label: For teams
landing.audiences.3.title: One infrastructure for every coach
landing.audiences.3.body: Shared client plans, consistent methods and clear outcomes across sports, nutrition, mindset and habits.
landing.steps.1.title: Share your goal
landing.steps.1.body: Tell us what you want to change. A race, a habit, your food, your focus. Any coach type, any level.
landing.steps.2.title: Meet your coach
landing.steps.2.body: We match you with a vetted coach who sets the plan with you in a first session.
landing.steps.3.title: Your agent tracks the plan
landing.steps.3.body: A personal assistant agent breaks the plan into daily steps, checks in and adjusts when life changes.
landing.steps.4.title: Coach reviews, you progress
landing.steps.4.body: Your coach sees the week in one view and spends the session on what matters, not on catching up.
landing.features.1.title: Personal assistant agent
landing.features.1.body: Daily check-ins, reminders and logging that follow your coach’s plan.
landing.features.2.title: Coach matching
landing.features.2.body: Vetted coaches across disciplines, matched by goal, schedule and style.
landing.features.3.title: One shared plan
landing.features.3.body: Coach and client see the same plan, progress and notes in real time.
landing.features.4.title: Session prep
landing.features.4.body: The agent summarises the week so each session starts with context.
landing.features.5.title: Adaptive scheduling
landing.features.5.body: Missed a day? The plan reshuffles without anyone chasing.
landing.features.6.title: Works for any discipline
landing.features.6.body: Sports, nutrition, mindset, habits and whatever comes next.
